description.value: An unscrubbable mark — it can't be scrubbed, painted over, or magically concealed by anything of lower rank than this spell. You always know when the marked creature or object is within 60 feet of you.

cinderfall.incomplete: An unscrubbable tracking mark + always knowing a specific marked creature's presence within 60 ft. TokenMark (PAT-TOKENMARK) can tag the target as 'marked' for use elsewhere, but no concrete rule-element JSON for that half was worked out with confidence to cite, and there is no rule element that grants a distance/direction sense to a specific individually-marked creature at all (Sense only grants standard named senses like darkvision with a fixed radius, not target-specific tracking) -- the tracking half is confirmed unbuildable.
